tray.restarting: Owlbot stopped unexpectedly and is starting again
tray.failed: Owlbot keeps stopping, so it was not started again. Choose Restart to try once more, or Show log to see why.
tray.portBusy: Port {port} is taken by another program, so Owlbot cannot start. Close that program and choose Restart.
tray.noRuntime: Owlbot's files are damaged. Install Owlbot again.
setup.autostart: Start Owlbot when I sign in
mac.welcome.title: Welcome to Owlbot
mac.welcome.body:
Owlbot is your personal agent. It runs in the background on this Mac and you talk to it in your browser.

After the install it starts by itself and opens in your browser, where you choose a password. Your chats, agents and the vault stay on this Mac.
mac.conclusion.title: Owlbot is installed
mac.conclusion.body:
Owlbot runs in the background and starts when you log in. It is opening in your browser now; later, open it from Applications.

To remove it, move Owlbot from Applications to the Trash. Your data stays in ~/Library/Application Support/Owlbot.
mac.moveFirst: Owlbot is running from its disk image. Drag it to the Applications folder first, then open it from Applications.
mac.notStarted: Owlbot did not start. The log is in {file}.
